title: Optimal transport: discretization and algorithms
tldr_zh: 以 Kantorovich 对偶为主线自包含分析 auction、Sinkhorn、半离散 Oliker–Prussner/阻尼 Newton 的讲义，半离散 OT 最佳入口
tldr_en: Handbook chapter giving self-contained convergence analyses of auction, Sinkhorn-Knopp and semi-discrete (Laguerre-cell, damped Newton) algorithms via Kantorovich duality.
key_numbers: Thm 22: auction from psi=0 takes at most N(C/eps+1) steps, N^2(C/eps+1) operations; Thm 24: eps-scaling gives O(N^3 log(C/eta)) (Sec. 3.2)
Thm 35: Sinkhorn map is a contraction with constant 1-exp(-2||c||_{o,inf}/eta); Remark 15: k >~ exp(2C/eta) log(1/eps) iterations (Sec. 3.3)
Cor. 16: grad K(psi) = (mu(Lag_y(psi)) - nu_y)_y when cell boundaries are null (Sec. 2.3)
Prop. 37: for any prices psi, T_psi is optimal between rho and T_psi#rho (Sec. 4.1)
